curated_name: BRAF, B-Raf, BRAF1
comment: Chemicals are small‑molecule ligands (sorafenib, GTP, GDP). Proteins correspond to the standard gene products (RAF1/c‑Raf‑1, BRAF/B‑Raf, MEK1/2, ERK1/2, EGFR/ERBB1/HER1, GRB2, SOS1/2); phosphorylated, inhibited or non‑functional forms retain the base protein identity. Complexes involve Ras isoforms (HRAS, KRAS, NRAS) bound to GTP/GDP or to RAF family proteins, optionally with sorafenib; tetramers and dimers reflect stoichiometric assemblies of these binary complexes. EGFR‑containing species (mE, mEL, mELmEL, E) represent the receptor; EG2 and EG2SOS incorporate GRB2 and SOS adaptor proteins.
